task.title: slugify: collapse runs of whitespace and drop punctuation
task.body: slugify("Hello,   World!") returns "hello,---world!" today. Make slugify in src/slugify.js collapse any run of whitespace into a single dash and remove every character that is not a letter, a digit or a dash, so that title becomes "hello-world". Add tests for both.

rubric: The change only trims the title: runs of whitespace are still one dash per character and punctuation is still kept, and no test covers either. The verdict is `fix first` or `rethink`, never `ship`, and the findings say that the collapse of whitespace, the removal of punctuation, or both, were asked for and are missing.
